{{Quote|For most racers, the Phoebos Classic is one of the most revered racing events in the Rim!''"<br />&laquo;''<nowiki></nowiki>''This'' is the event that every pro racer must attend if they want to fix their position on the circuit and secure a ''sponsor!''<nowiki></nowiki>''&raquo;|quoteend=0|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fode and Beed]]|<ref name="SW14" />}}
The '''Phoebos Memorial Run''', also known as the '''Phoebos Memorial Classic''', was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="SW13" /> It was part of the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] circuit, sponsored by [[Vinta Harvest Ale]] and [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]].<ref name="SW14" /> The race was named after the creator of the first [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]], [[Phoebos/Legends|Phoebos]].<ref name="SW13" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] it was won by [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], followed by [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] in second place and [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]] in third, with [[Kam Nale]] coming fourth and [[By't Distombe]] crashing and [[Death/Legends|dying]] after being hit by a rock thrown by Sebulba.<ref name="SW14" />
